dataFlows.transformKql:
source 
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(ts), action = tostring(audit.action), level = tostring(audit.level), resourceName = tostring(audit.resourceName), resourceType = tostring(audit.resourceType), service = todynamic(audit.service), tags = todynamic(audit.tags), user = todynamic(audit.user), eventTime = todatetime(ts) 
| extend ipAddress = tostring(iff(isempty(service.ipAddress), user.ipAddress, service.ipAddress)) 
| extend GeoLocation = geo_location(ipAddress) 
| extend SrcGeoCountry = tostring(GeoLocation.Country), SrcGeoCity = tostring(GeoLocation.City), SrcGeoRegion = tostring(GeoLocation.Region), SrcGeoLongitude = toreal(GeoLocation.Longitude), SrcGeoLatitude = toreal(GeoLocation.Latitude) 
| project-away ts, audit, GeoLocation
